# Recorded responses

`sts-11.12.0` holds what the public routes `dr platform describe` reads returned on an 11.12.0 single-tenant install. It was reconstructed from the field values an engineer printed from that install, with the host, names, and IDs replaced. Envelopes and field names follow the public API. Re-record it with a real run when one is available.

`{{BASE}}` stands for the test server's address.
